ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: priest
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the colony's gods: dedicates its shrines, carries its offerings, leads the festivals' rites, and sits with anyone whose prayers went unanswered.

duties.li: Dedicates the places the colony gives to its gods, and carries the offerings left there.
Leads each god's festival rite at its shrine.
Prays with those who ask; people say the gods come to the priest in dreams.
Only with the gods on and a god the colony holds; with Ideology and a faith of the colony's own, the chaplain does this instead. Opens once the colony has four people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says no god of the colony's will want for an offering again.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the gods have been patient with this colony, and means to give them less to be patient about.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked for one thing first: that nobody eat the offerings.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} promises every god's festival kept, and an offering at each shrine in its season.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the gods have not forgotten the colony in its hard days, and promises to pray with anyone who asks.

HediffDef.label: priest
HediffDef.description: Holds the priest's seat: keeps the colony's gods.

li.promise: to pray with anyone who asked

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} promises a word with anyone whose prayers have gone unanswered.
li.promise: a word for anyone whose prayers went unanswered

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} promises that the colony's dead will be prayed for, every one.
li.promise: that the colony's dead would be prayed for

plain.li: [plank:unanswered] If your prayers have gone unanswered, come and sit with me a while.
[plank:dead] Every one of our dead will be prayed for, I promise you that.
[plank:unanswered] Nobody whose prayers went unanswered will be left to sit alone with it.
[plank:dead] Our dead will be prayed for by name, every one of them, as long as I hold this seat.
